name: Icon / Status Symbol
description: Status Symbol product scenario for the Icon component.

controls.name: name
controls.description: Built-in Face UI icon name. An unknown name renders the notdef glyph; an empty one renders nothing.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible name of a meaningful icon; without it and `title` the icon is decorative.

controls.name: title
controls.description: SVG title: native pointer hint and accessible name when aria-label is absent.
